decisions.reason: A black-finish variant extends the established range at low cost, fits current design trends, and in a growing industry with ample slack gives no shortfall that would prompt dropping it.
A shower channel for seamless coverings is core to the firm's barrier-free bathroom strategy and has its own page, which signals satisfactory results against aspirations.
The pump-assisted solution is more uncertain and only mentioned on the website, but growing turnover and organisational slack let the firm carry it while it matures.
A tileable floor drain is a natural extension of core know-how, has its own page, and likely meets aspiration levels.
A stainless steel design grate fits the firm's design-led positioning and own manufacturing, so there is little reason for problemistic search.
